Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original square World of Warcraft addon logo for Palaver, an addon that shows quest and NPC conversations in a large reading panel, part of a collection of richly hand-painted fantasy inventory-item addon icons.
Primary request: one finished square icon of a stout antique speech bubble made of thick warm parchment held in a heavy gilded brass rim. Make the speech bubble the only hero object, clear and recognisable at 32-64 pixels.
Subject and composition: a large rounded speech bubble seen almost face on with a slight three-quarter tilt so its brass rim has substantial depth. Its short curled tail points down to the lower left. The parchment face is cream and honey coloured with soft painted fibres and slightly darkened edges. Three large round embossed gold studs sit in a row across its centre, like a conversation still going, each with a bright sculpted highlight. A narrow dark turquoise enamel band runs just inside the brass rim, with one small emerald cabochon set where the tail meets the bubble. Centre the full object, filling approximately 85 percent of the square while keeping all edges visible and a small dark margin. Strong weighty silhouette, few large readable forms, excellent thumbnail contrast.
Style and medium: polished hand-painted fantasy game inventory illustration. Chunky slightly exaggerated geometry, expressive angular brushstrokes, richly textured metal and parchment, thick gilded edges, bright sculpted yellow-gold highlights and warm orange shadows. Saturated turquoise and emerald accents, very subtle cool blue rim light. The brushwork must be visibly painterly and detailed, matching an illustrated fantasy tome or battle-shield icon rather than a realistic product render.
Backdrop: full-bleed opaque deep inky midnight-navy square with a restrained blue painterly vignette behind the object. Quiet backdrop, dark corners. No outer decorative frame or rounded tile.
Constraints: one finished icon only, no text, letters, runes, typography, labels, exclamation or question marks, watermark, logo sheet, mockup, UI screenshot, books, scrolls, quills, keys, shield, flame, wind ribbons, faction crests, character, face, mouth, hands or scenery. No photorealism, glossy 3D render, flat vector style, filigree clutter, chains, scattered sparkles or huge magical aura. The design should feel like a useful rare-quality Azeroth inventory item, with the warm parchment and gold rim dominating.
